release.content: pubkit 0.35.0 was released on 2026-11-10 from commit 1d4ed6bf0f9f6f7c800975f004efcd1576f5c0d2 with these changes.

rows: pubkit pins, and the nightly, also move another repository's action (OWNER/REPO/actions/NAME@) and its Terraform module sources in .tf files (source = "github.com/OWNER/REPO//PATH?ref=...") to that repository's latest release, by its tag's commit with the version in a comment; a module pinned by tag moves to the commit form

pubkit sync --check and conform fail on a pin of a pubkit action, reusable workflow or Terraform module this pubkit does not ship (refs.SHIPPED, held to the tree by a test), and pins leaves such a pin where it is instead of moving it to a pubkit that lacks it

The nightly moves third-party GitHub Actions in place of Dependabot: pubkit actions (and a nightly commit of its own) moves each action a hand-written workflow or composite action pins by commit to its latest release, by its tag's commit, and the managed dependabot.yml sets open-pull-requests-limit 0 on github-actions, so Dependabot opens only security updates; update.actions false keeps Dependabot's version updates

pubkit sync fails when pubkit.json's protect.checks requires a check that none of the repository's workflows reports where the ruleset waits for it (the merge queue's commit, or with no queue the pull request's), naming it; SonarCloud Code Analysis counts only where a workflow scans on every such run, which the generated pr.yml does not do in the queue

The hosting half of pubkit is pubhost's (Sustenaut/pubhost 0.1.0): the Terraform modules (terraform/), terraform.yml, the deploy-static and docker-build actions, pubkit dns check and pubkit site check (dns moves, the 0.12.6 key migration, is dropped). pubkit keeps the hosting block's shape, which sync checks, and the ci / site job, which now runs the deploy-static the repository's own deploy workflow pins
